payload.title: Overwatch board initialized
payload.body: This board tracks Blue, Red, Green, and Overwatch work for the Hapa Black Horizon MVP. Board state is derived from append-only events.

payload.title: Create reusable Overwatch Kanban protocol
payload.description: Define append-only events, board columns, communication rules, telemetry projections, and reusable coordination scaffolding.
acceptance: UI, API, CLI, and data surfaces exist
Protocol documentation explains source of truth and record rule

payload.title: Generate 10-node fleet manifest
payload.description: Blue scans Hapa node facts and emits deterministic ship definitions for the first Black Horizon MVP fleet.

payload.title: Capture node metrics snapshot
payload.description: Blue records branch, commit, docs/scripts/tests signals, repo status, and provenance for ship stat generation.
acceptance: Each stat input has a provenance trail
Dirty or unknown repo facts are labeled

payload.title: Create HapaBlackHorizonFleetMVP scene
payload.description: Red creates the Unity scene, artifact center, orbit lanes, station anchors, and manifest-driven bootstrap.
acceptance: FleetBootstrap loads manifest or temporary sample data
Orbit lanes and artifact center are visible

payload.title: Map five ship classes to visual treatments
payload.description: Red uses safe kit references or generated placeholders to make command, telemetry, forge, media, and shield ships distinct.
acceptance: Repo state can affect material/status lights

payload.title: Build semantic input router
payload.description: Green creates keyboard/mouse commands that can later be fed by phone/WebSocket events without rewriting the interaction layer.
acceptance: Commands include select, focus, play duty card, cancel

payload.title: Prototype Telemetry Patrol duty card
payload.description: Green implements the first safe visual duty: a scan/sweep from the telemetry ship that updates status rings without touching repos.
acceptance: Result is represented as a replay/checkpoint event

payload.title: Run MVP integration smoke
payload.description: Overwatch verifies manifest, Unity compile, scene open path, selection loop, and first duty replay before marking the MVP slice done.
acceptance: Smoke output uses Hapa protocol report shape
Final checkpoint summarizes what is verified vs inferred

payload.body: Overwatch online. Blue owns truth/data, Red owns Unity world, Green owns interaction/demo. All coordination notes should be appended here so the board can be replayed later.

payload.title: Initial split checkpoint
payload.summary: MVP split is established: Blue compiler, Red Unity scene, Green interaction, Overwatch protocol and integration tracking.
open: Wire this board into recurring project practice
